reviews.text: Wonderful and trusted animal hospital.  My senior cat developed cancer and Dr. Maldonado explained all treatment options to us. We ended up putting her down and the care her staff and herself provided was exceptional.

I want to say thank you to the amazing team here. Not too long ago I had a very traumatic experience at an emergency vet where my fur baby wasn’t properly weighed before medication and the ladies at this office helped soothe the fear I had even bringing him in.

They’ve soothed every fear and concern I come to them with and always greet me with smiles. When speaking about my fur baby, Loki, they’re VERY attentive and make sure to get all the details so they can provide whatever I need for my little old man to feel better/ thrive as best he can at his age (and his weight…… chunky lil guy)

I deeply appreciate their patience with me as I do have quite bad anxiety, but they’re always so kind whether it be over the phone or in office!

I also appreciate their affordability! Especially after JUST visiting an animal er last night and spending a LOT there, I was so scared of pricing, but they’ve always surprised me with how affordable the care is and I’m so thankful.

They took great care of my parents fur baby so I trust them with mine and they’ve shown me why my parents love them so much. Definitely a place I’d recommend if you want people who care fully about you and your little furbabies!

Thank you again for helping me with Loki through the rough patches! I can’t express how thankful I am for all of you at this office!

An edit to add:

I appreciate all of the care they showed me in another emergency my baby boy had. They helped me try to help him get better, working hard to ensure I had many tools to try.

Unfortunately I had to say goodbye to my baby Loki and I deeply appreciate the compassion this team showed my boy Loki and myself in his final moments. Thank you again.

Everyone in this office are truly angels who care so deeply about our animal companions.

Has always been an exceptional vet clinic to go to, I’m so glad our family has them to care for our pets to the highest degree possible. They do amazing work and truly care for all animals - we even adopted our current kittens from them as a vet tech found them and they have been a huge blessing ever since.
Thanks, we try to keep things manageable. It is hard with all the prices going up all the time,  We love you!

Best Vet experience ever! Dr. Maldonado spent time with us and answered all of our questions. She showed compassion for our dog Fred. We will return and also take our other dogs to see her. The whole team was kind, courteous,  and professional. Great vet clinic. We have taken our 4 dogs to see Dr. Maldonado for years. Her team always takes care of our boys. We also board our dogs when we need to travel. Great prices.

First off the staff is incredibly sweet , they handled my baby with care & took great care of him, called me checking in on him & reminded of upcoming appts. X is doing great! Thank y’all so much! This is where you will wanna take your furbabies to, amazing staff!
I adore Dr. Maldonado. She has been treating my fur babies for more than 30 years now for everything from annual shots to final good-byes. I wouldn't go anywhere else with my cats.

The front‑desk staff and techs were wonderful, but the doctor made the visit uncomfortable. She spoke rudely to her staff and then addressed me in a condescending way about a supposed scheduling issue. We came in for a nail trim and rabies shot — the appointment was booked, and they had our other dog’s exam records. Instead of calmly explaining the policy, she criticized her staff and told me she “shouldn’t have done” the services. It was an unnecessary and unprofessional interaction. The staff deserves better, and so do the clients.

We took my baby here yesterday for a concern.. city vet had, in the same day…quoted us almost 1600 for a “cancer diagnosis”. Luckily his normal vet, Assure in converse, called during his city vet appointment and was able to get him in.
When we left city vet I had a feeling we were getting the 1,2,3 punch.  We get to assure vet and they laughed at the quote from city vet.   City vet scared us to death over a benign SKIN TAG..!!!! That assure vet told us to just go to Walmart and get a bottle of liquid bandage and DIY it for $12. Yes we paid for two vet visits the same day but luckily Assure in converse called and saved us from getting R@ped at city vet.  These people are AMAZING and compassionate with my dog and kid aggressive baby.

Love Dr Maldonado she’s so kind and thorough. The bad reviews I read before coming are totally false- I’m so glad we just came in and gave them a chance with our baby.  Pricing is reasonable and they’re not gouging people- they have budget friendly options for you like combining a neuter with a dental to save money.  The people that said city vet was bad- that’s true.  We used them before and we were happy to get into assure yesterday at 4:30.

Champ, our baby, is always given thorough and complete care when needed here and they don’t gouge you like some places.  Thank you Dr. Maldonado for your compassion and empathy, and for saving us THOUSANDS from another vets quote.  He’s also dog cat and kid aggressive and they’re very mindful of that when we schedule, and get us right in and out and also stay on top of his trazadone for outings- he’s fine at home but will bite small kids due to harassment from a neighbors kids when he was younger.  We LOVE assure and thank you guys so much for caring for Champ.

ALSO- yes it does sound like the receptionist is eating while talking but that’s someone’s tic if you will- the fact that this vet hires people with age and disabilities says alot about them and I’m sickened to read the bad reviews for this vet based on “rude receptionist”… when it’s just a minor disability.

♥️ the Johnson’s 9119 Sahara woods is our address if anyone doesn’t like what we have to say.
Our experience has been fantastic since coming here. The staff is friendly and scheduling is pretty flexible.

I’ve been taken my baby there for years (approximately 6) I brought my baby in 3- months ago and I told that Doctor my baby start showing signs of arthritis, she told me my baby was ok.. She was so wrong as my baby just got a lot worse w/I that 3-months why cause that didn’t listen to me after she is my baby and I saw it!
Called today to tell that doc my baby is in pain and she did nothing!! She wanted me to comeback and she and pay almost 70- plus the pain meds she showed no empathy or compassion for either me or my dog. On top of all this I have lung cancer and I just had major surgery!
I looked at her comparison between her and the Kirby so I only let a vet mess up bad once! I’m going to Kirby and won’t look back! Done w/ her lack of care!!

We’ve been going to Assure Vet since 2001, and they have consistently provided exceptional care for our family pets. Leesa Maldonado has always been incredibly compassionate, patient, and extremely thorough at every visit. She truly takes the time to listen, explain, and make sure both pets and owners feel comfortable and cared for. After more than two decades of trusting Assure Vet with our animals, we couldn’t imagine going anywhere else. Highly recommend.

I have NEVER been here, this is purely based on the receptionist answering the phone. Very rude, kept cutting me off and was literally eating while I was speaking with her. Mind you, my dog has cancer and I’m trying to end his suffering. I was told I need to pay their exam fee JUST to see what the vet recommends even though I can provide paperwork for his diagnosis. I was insistent on euthanasia as my boys health has declined drastically and I know he’s in pain just to be told that the vet also has to agree with euthanasia which sounds like if she says no, I can’t euthanize him. They don’t deal with aggressive dogs so it’s not for us, but gross behavior for a receptionist considering my heart is already hurting. Fire her and DO BETTER.

Dr. Maldonado really seems to care. My sweet Cabo who recently passed away was seeing two vets and I always favored Maldonado. She and her staff sent me a very sweet condolences when I lost Cabo. The other vet who I had to rush Cabo to sent notthing. The personnel touch means everything.

I adopted Abby from a gentleman walking around trying to give away a 6 week old puppy. I snatched her up. I googled vets in my area and Assure was the closest. I made an appointment that Monday and got to meet Dr. Maldonado and crew; I was impressed. Abby had a few issues, but she became healthy girl quickly.

Fast-forward about a year later, I sought a companion for my lonely girl while I was at work; enter Maddy whom I adopted from Converse Animal Shelter. I called Assure and expressed the need to have her seen, and with no hesitation took her to see Dr. Maldonado early that week and she was good to go with zero issues.  It took a while to house-train 1 year old Maddy, but she is trained.

Fast-forward about 9 months when I saw a sweetheart lost girl on the Nextdoor app. The couple who were caring for Quan(topolis) brought her to my home to see if she'd fit in and she did. I called Assure just before closing time and was given an early spot Monday or Tuesday. Now, not saying Dr. Maldonado is judgemental, but when she walked in the room to me with yet another, I sensed a little "really? Another one?" Lol.  She checked her out with 0 issues and I left.
My experience with this practice has been five stars throughout. I am 100% positive that my girls need a lifelong doctor and that's what they have in Dr. Maldonado. She is knowledgeable, caring and seems to be pa-retty darn good with my girls. Her staff are also knowledgeable, considerate and listen intently to what I have to say.

To end, this is where you should have your pets checked, because they are a quality practice which imposes exceptional value. I was lucky to have chosen them because who knows what else is out there, and I've heard stories.

I went there for 3 years with all my kitties. Leesa is a wonderful doctor and really has a heart for her patients. Donna was my favorite receptionist and she was always so helpful and kind with everything. My cat Oreo was diagnosed with cancer there and so we were in there a lot for blood work and urine samples. They took care of her right until the end of her life. Great people and staff. I always recommend them to anyone in the San Antonio area looking for a vets office.

My chihuahua got attacked a couple of months ago. We took him to Assure Vet since it was closest to the house. The vet agreed to see him even though they were literally about to close. She was really compassionate. We are now moving all of our dogs to this clinic. Thank you so much for taking care of my pup!

I was able to get my dog Hermione in quickly when I noticed a fractured canine tooth. She was assessed for this as well as itchy skin and to get up to date on her vaccines. All of the staff was amazing, and Hermione got many treats. She came back for a follow up and the charge for this was low, which I and my wallet greatly appreciated. She also ended up having dental surgery and the cost was reasonable for this, as well. I'm thankful for Dr. Maldonado and her staff, you can tell they truly care about the animals in their care. I also appreciate their hours and that I've been lucky to schedule at the end of the day so that I am not having to take off work in order to make appointments.

I’ve honestly had such a great experience with them. I wanna start off by saying Donna is such a joy to speak with. Her customer service skills are impeccable and her empathy with pet owners is unmatched no first time taking my dogs. There was a different lady at the reception desk and unfortunately, I forget her name, but she was very kind and expressed worry about my baby. The vet was in very fast. They were so understanding they were quick, gentle and kind. It did not seem like money hungry like some other places we’ve been they do not try to nickel and dime. They work with your budget and are  understanding . Thank you so much for loving my babies and making us feel so comfortable beautiful clean facilities.

My dog was provided Temaril P for allergies, and I clearly explained several times that she needed a prescription for this medication before I left and this was acknowledged. However, I was later contacted for a follow-up appointment and informed that they would not renew the prescription because the medication had a steroid in it and they wanted to put her on another medication. For what, another $100+ appointment and waste of time? I refused the appointment and feel absolutely scammed. Many medications have steroids in them, my dog's been prescribed steroids in the past, in moderation. Will not be returning.

Remove "HOSPITAL" from your name if you are not actually a friggin hospital. I called to get help for my dog during an emergency and they turned me down because there wasn't an appointment for a week out.....    HOSPITAL means something else to me I guess.

I’m disappointed because I am trying to get care for an injured stray, and I made an appointment at this Animal Hospital.  They wouldn’t make the appointment without me paying them $50 in advance to reserve that appointment.  When I called …

I went to ask a question,the lady at the front desk acted like I didn't have monet. She kept repeating the deposit like I wouldn't pay it. Then I was talking to her and she just got up and started talking to someone else. I just got up and walked out.  I would not recommend

I called asking what vaccs are needed to be seen. They receptionist who answered didn't answer my question and went straight to saying "well we see by appt only" in a blunt mannee. I told her I understood, but it was not my question. She …
Not taking new patients. Don't know how they expect to make money with that business ethic.

I am so grateful for Dr. Maldonado and all the staff. They were so kind and thorough with my cats exam and dental cleaning. Everyone was so professional, friendly and WARM. Thank you Dr. Maldonado and staff for helping my baby being so wonderful!

Both my dogs Buzz Lightning and Bob go to Assure VET. I feel confident  in Dr Maldonado treatment and care and am greatful that she loves what she does. My fur babies are happy and healthy because of the staff at Assure Vet.
